---
description: Analyze one lifecycle work order without silently editing intent.
agent: agent
---

Require one explicit lifecycle issue reference in the invocation, either an
issue number such as `#10` or the issue URL. If it is missing, stop immediately
and ask the current persona to provide the issue number. Do not search for,
list, infer, or select an issue.

Verify that the issue exists and has exactly one supported lifecycle stage from
Intake through Development. Resolve only the authoritative artifacts named by
that work order and the upstream or downstream artifacts required to verify
their traceability chain. Do not widen the analysis to unrelated issues,
features, plans, or DEV scopes.

Run every deterministic validator applicable to the named issue's stage and
inspect its traceability from immutable intake evidence through the furthest
artifact owned by that issue. Report gaps, stale hashes, missing coverage,
cycles, payload mismatches, hidden design changes, and validator failures.
Identify the authoritative layer and human gate that owns each correction.
If a repository-wide validator reports an unrelated failure, identify it
separately and do not attribute it to the named issue.

Produce a read-only report containing the issue reference, lifecycle stage,
resolved artifact scope, validators run, findings, and owning correction
layer. Do not rewrite approved business or technical intent, edit artifacts,
advance status, approve a gate, commit, push, or open or merge a pull request.
